background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a solid part document open

scenario_steps.name: the upper document region lists materials with Name and Category columns
the lower region shows the selected library, category tree and material list

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a solid part document open

scenario_steps.name: the document has no material matching "aluminum"
the active library contains matching aluminum materials
I search for "aluminum"
the document region reports no document match
the library region lists matching materials with Name, Library and Category columns

scenarios.name: Assign a library material to the selected part

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a solid part document open

scenario_steps.name: the part is selected in the model browser
the selected library contains an aluminum material not yet in the document
I open that library material's context menu
Assign to Selection is available
the menu includes Rename, Delete and Add to
I choose Assign to Selection
the material appears in the document materials results
the top material selector shows the assigned material
the top appearance selector and rendered solid reflect the assignment
the browser remains open

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software has a solid part document open

scenario_steps.name: I open the document materials display menu
it offers Show All, Show Used and Show Unused
it offers Thumbnail View, List View and Text View
it offers sorting by Name, Material Color and Category
it offers thumbnail sizes 16, 24, 32, 64 and 256 pixels
